_about: What the shop owner put in the brain after reading the bot's answers: facts the handbook left unclear, and the complete answer to each of the most-asked questions. Level 3 adds them at start and checks the curated answers before anything it learned itself.

facts.title: Free hemming covers full-price jeans and trousers bought at Kestrel Row in store or online; sale items are hemmed from $15
facts.body: Online orders count as bought at Kestrel Row. Bring the item to the alterations counter, lower floor.

facts.title: Buy online, pick up in store (BOPIS) is free, ready in 2 hours during store hours and held for 7 days
Personal shopping means our free 45-minute personal styling appointments, booked online or by phone
facts.body: A stylist helps the customer choose; there is no charge.

answers.title: What is your return policy?
answers.body: Full-price items: 30 days from purchase (from delivery for online orders), unworn with tags and with the receipt or order number, refunded to the original payment. Holiday purchases from Nov 1 to Dec 24 can be returned until Jan 15. Sale items: 14 days, store credit or exchange only. FINAL SALE items, underwear, swimwear without the liner, earrings, gift cards and altered items can't be returned. No receipt: store credit at the lowest price in the last 30 days, with photo ID.

answers.title: How much is shipping?
answers.body: Standard shipping (3-5 business days) is free over $100, otherwise $8. Express (2 business days) is $18. Same-day courier in Manhattan is $25 if you order by 1pm. Buy online and pick up in store is free, ready in 2 hours. We ship to all 50 states; no international shipping.

answers.title: Do you hem jeans, and is hemming free?
answers.body: Yes. Hemming is free on full-price jeans and trousers bought at Kestrel Row, in store or online. Sale items are not hemmed free: hemming them costs from $15, like other alterations (sleeves $25, taking in a waist $20). Ready in 5 business days, or in 48 hours for $15 extra. Pick up at the alterations counter on the lower floor. Altered items can't be returned.

answers.title: What is your exchange policy?
answers.body: You can exchange an item for the same piece in a different size or color, free, in store or online: within 30 days for full-price items and 14 days for sale items. Items marked FINAL SALE and altered items can't be exchanged.

answers.title: Can I return something without a receipt?
answers.body: Yes. If you paid by card or have a Row Rewards account, we can look the purchase up and the normal return rules apply. Otherwise you get store credit at the lowest price of the last 30 days, with photo ID, up to 3 no-receipt returns a year.

answers.title: Do you sell gift cards?
answers.body: Yes, from $25 to $500: a plastic card in store (with a free gift box) or an e-gift card online, sent by email. They never expire, and you can check the balance at the register, on the website or by phone. They can't be exchanged for cash.

answers.title: Do gift cards expire?
answers.body: No, Kestrel Row gift cards never expire. You can check the balance at the register, on the website or by phone.
